name: Madangad Fort
description: Madangad is the twin of Alang and part of the legendary AMK (Alang-Madan-Kulang) trek. Known for its steep rock patches, exposed traverses, and thrilling climb, Madangad is a favorite among experienced trekkers. The summit offers panoramic views of the Sahyadris.

routes.name: AMK Circuit
routes.description: Steep rock faces, exposed traverses, and technical climbing. Rope and gear required for some sections.

landmarks.name: Summit Plateau
landmarks.description: Narrow summit with breathtaking views of Alang, Kulang, and the Sahyadris.

landmarks.name: Rock Patches
landmarks.description: Steep and exposed rock climbs, highlight of the trek.

landmarks.name: Caves
landmarks.description: Small caves for overnight stay (limited capacity).

history.significance: Strategic hill fort, part of the AMK circuit, used as a watchtower and refuge.

reviews: Madangad is the most thrilling climb in the AMK circuit. The rock patch is both scary and exciting!
Carry ropes and trek with experienced guides. The views are worth every bit of effort.
Not for beginners. The summit is narrow but the scenery is unmatched.
